# Known emule ASAN sweep findings — Nightly ASAN Sweep allowlist.
#
# Format: one `<Category>|<site>` key per line; `#` starts a comment.
# `<site>` is a source basename with an optional `:<line>` (never a full path, so
# a key stays valid across workspaces). The exact keys a run produced are in its
# `known-asan-findings.candidate.txt` report artifact.
#
# Purpose: split the nightly report into "known" and "NEW". The lane is
# report-only, so nothing here changes whether the run passes — it changes what
# the summary calls new. This is also the hook that would let the lane become a
# gate (fail only on new keys) without redesigning the report.
#
# A key belongs here only once someone has triaged the finding and decided it
# should not re-alarm — a tracked-and-accepted bug, or a confirmed false
# positive with a linked issue. Adding an untriaged key hides a real metal bug,
# which is the one failure mode this whole lane exists to prevent. Prefer a
# noisy report over a quiet allowlist.
#
# Deliberately empty: no finding has been triaged at the current tt-metal pin.
# Earlier manual sweeps found real bugs, but at older pins and older check
# semantics, so those keys are not carried over unverified.
